title: Exits await Telegram alerts that have no timeout before sending the sell, and the watchdog awaits one after an overrun, so a hung Telegram request delays sells and the worker

evidence.note: await sendCtxAlert before the public-fallback approve and swap
await sendCtxAlert before the partial submit
the watchdog awaits sendCtxAlert after an overrun before returning false, so the freed drain loop waits on Telegram
sendCtxAlert: await axios.post(TELEGRAM_API, ...) with no timeout option

sibling_sites_checked: Every awaited sendCtxAlert in the slice: before the money action (:533, :893, :1521) and after it (:744, :751, :950, :966, :1010, :1031, :1104, :1155, :1166, :1583, exitWatchdog.ts:75). Errors are caught in notifier, so only a hang matters. The worker watchdog does bound the whole submit, so a hang there is capped at the budget; the anti-rug path is capped by its withTimeout, which then counts the exit as failed.
severity_rationale: S2: proven by the code; the condition is a stalled Telegram API connection. Delaying an exit is a bounded loss, and the watchdog and anti-rug budgets cap the delay (while turning it into a failed exit).
recommendation: Never await an alert before a money action (fire and forget with a short timeout), and give the notifier a request timeout. Card EXIT-04. Phase 24 for the pre-sell awaits.
